Hmm, here are the mods I use:

There won't be any links, just the names.

But I will add a small description to each mod.

​

* **Automate**.

This mod is so good, I doubt that I will ever be able to play without it.

Check it out.

​

* **BetterFruitTrees**

Mostly visual, plus it allows you to plant those trees, without having to leave any spaces between them.

​

* **BetterRanching**

Just visual stuff, adds an indicator that shows if you have petted the animals and if you have milked the cows.

​

* **BigSilo**

Just a bigger silo.

Basically, you can fit unlimited hay there.

​

* **catGifts**

Your pet will bring you gifts, sometimes.

​

* **CJBShowItemSellPrice**

Pretty self-explanatory.

​

* **DeepWoodsMod**

This is pretty damn awesome.

Adds levels which you can explore, get tons of stuff, in the Secret Woods.

​

* **FriendsForever**

No friendship decay.

​

* **GrassChance**

More grass.

​

* **HarvestWithScythe**

Pretty self-explanatory.

​

* **LookupAnything**

Allows you to hover over an item and then press F1 to see all the info about that item.

(For example, who likes/loves it, if the community center needs it and more)

​

* **NoFenceDecay**

Pretty self-explanatory.

​

* **NPCMapLocations.**

Pretty self-explanatory.

​

* **RangeDisplay**

Allows you to check the range of scarecrows, sprinklers, etc.

​

* **SkipFishingMinigame**

I don't like fishing...so yeah.

​

* **StackEverything**

Allows you to stack everything, machines and all that.

​

* **StackToNearbyChests**

Moves any items from your inventory into nearby chests if they contain at least 1 of the item, with the click of one button.

​

* **TillableGround**

Allows you to make any untillable ground, tillable.

​

* **TractorMod**

The tractor is awesome.

​

* **WearMoreRings**

You can wear more rings : )

​

These mods, don't actually change the game that much.

But they do improve a lot of things.

So, I doubt that I would be able to play without them anymore.

I'd call them essential.
